info.title: btmux REST API
info.description: Manage sessions, windows, and panes, drive pane input and output, and coordinate coding agents. Every request sends the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

How much of each subscription limit Claude Code and Codex accounts on the server have used, and when each resets. Agents using an API key, or not logged in, aren't listed.

post.description: Creates a Git worktree for `branch` beside the pane's repository (the `worktree-path` setting) and opens a window in it.

Which optional programs the server found and whether they run

post.description: Re-executes the server as another btmux binary, as `btmux upgrade` does, keeping sessions, shells, and scrollback. `GET /api/info` then reports the new version, or `upgrade_error` if the exec failed.

202.description: Upgrading; clients reconnect to the new binary

400.description: A malformed JSON body

409.description: This server can't hand off to that binary; only a restart can

413.description: A body over the size limit

422.description: A body that doesn't match its schema

423.description: An upgrade is in progress, or the built-in Neovim has unsaved changes

200.description: The OpenAPI document for this server's version

plan.description: As the CLI reports it, e.g. `max` or `prolite`.

updated_at.description: Unix seconds of the last successful read.

AgentPane.description: A pane running an agent, as listed to automation.

AgentState.description:
Lifecycle states for an agent occupying a pane.

This intentionally follows Herdr's small semantic vocabulary. Failure and
permission details belong in the accompanying message/notification instead
of multiplying lifecycle states.

background.description: Background work the agent's screen shows, such as "2 shells, 1 monitor".

totals.description: Over all retained history and models.

models.description: Most tokens first; an update holds only models with changed minutes.

input_tokens.description: Input includes cache reads and writes; cached tokens are a subset.

reasoning_tokens.description: Reasoning is a subset of output tokens.

oneOf.description: None once the agent has exited.

select.description: Make its window the active one.

Editor.description:
The editor `prefix + e`, `prefix + [`, the file browser, Git mode, and
`btmux open-editor` open. Unset, it is the native editor.

value.description: A version, or a word such as "Not found".

note.description: What is wrong, or what happens without it.

path.description: The server's `PATH`, where programs are looked up.

upgrade_error.description: Why the last `btmux upgrade` failed, if it did.

oneOf.description: With `--tailscale`, whether the tailnet URL is served yet.

InfoReply.description: `GET /api/info`: the fixed `ServerInfo` and what changes while it runs.

model.description: `None` is usage reported without a model, such as Claude's tool calls.

totals.description: Over all retained history, even when `buckets` holds only changed minutes.

opened.description: False when the caller should run `$EDITOR` itself.

path.description: The file to open; without one, the editor is just shown.

PaneAlert.description: A pane notification nobody has viewed yet.

PaneEditor.description: The native editor over a pane, the same in every tab.

files.description: Open files (absolute paths), in tab order.

PaneGit.description: A pane's place in a git repo.

repo_id.description: The repo's common git dir, shared by all its worktrees.

main_worktree.description: The repo's main worktree rather than a linked one.

PaneInfo.description:
One pane with its window and session, for `GET /api/panes` and the tmux-style
CLI. Fields are named like tmux format variables.

pane_index.description: Layout order, as `prefix + q` numbers panes.

cols.description:
Only used if the PTY hasn't been spawned yet (no browser has attached
to this pane). Ignored once a shell is already running.

newly_spawned.description:
True if this call caused the shell to spawn. Callers polling
`/output` afterward should expect a short delay before the shell
prints its first prompt.

session_id.description: Harness identity; shared by every event in one agent session.

turn_id.description: Turn identity, when the harness provides one.

prompt_id.description: Claude Code: shared by every event of one turn.

title.description: Explicit title (custom callers or Notification event).

last_assistant_message.description: Claude Code/Codex Stop and SubagentStop: last assistant message.

agent.description: Optional agent name for semantic status reporting.

source.description:
Optional reporter identity for semantic status reporting. SessionStart
hooks may use this field for their start reason instead.

timeout_ms.description:
How long to wait, in milliseconds: 10 minutes by default, at most an
hour.

agent_id.description: Names the running agent instance, so a client can target it.

agent_since.description: When the agent entered its current state, in Unix seconds.

oneOf.description: A command line for the pane's shell.

shell.description: A command line for the pane's shell.

status.description: The program's exit status, if known.

id.description:
Chosen by the caller, so a request retried across an upgrade finds
its popup rather than running the program again.

oneOf.description: None once the agent has exited.

started.description: Whether the agent was seen working on the prompt.

screen.description:
The rendered screen once output went quiet; None once the pane has
closed.

PromptReply.description: With `wait`, the turn's outcome; without, `{"submitted": true}`.

oneOf.description:
The shared Multipass instance, with these host directories mounted
at the same paths.

log_files.description: Daily log files; `None` when file logging is off.

instance.description: Changes on every start, including an in-place upgrade.

SessionSummary.description: One entry per session for the StatusBar and the session picker.

direction.description: Where the new pane goes: left, right, up, or down.

index.description:
Absolute window index, or the sentinels `-1` (next) / `-2` (prev) also
used by the `/ws/control` protocol.

shell.description: The shell new panes run, with its version when it reports one.

load.description: 1, 5, and 15 minute load; `null` where the OS has none.

oneOf.description: The last attempt failed; btmux keeps retrying.

TailscaleStatus.description: Whether `--tailscale` serves the tailnet URL yet.

executable.description: The btmux binary to run, an absolute path on the server.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds, rounded down to a minute.
